{"code":"def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); from collections import Counter
 base=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
 lr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x==base for x in r)>=w*.8]
 lc=[j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j]==base for i in range(h))>=h*.8]
 pts=[(i,j) for i in lr for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=base]+[(i,j) for j in lc for i in range(h) if g[i][j]!=base]
 if not pts:return [r[:] for r in g]
 rs=[p[0] for p in pts];cs=[p[1] for p in pts];a,b=min(rs),max(rs);c,d=min(cs),max(cs)
 return [r[c:d+1] for r in g[a:b+1]]"}
